learning_outcomes.text: To inform students at high risk of accidents by providing practical training on Occupational Health and Safety and to provide information on precautions to be taken.

syllabus_topics: Occupational safety in working with electric and non-electric hand tools and machines
Occupational safety in maintenance and repair works
Occupational safety in manual lifting and carrying tasks
Occupational health and safety in lifting equipment
First aid and first aid rules
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
